---
title: "Flight Route Map"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
---

```{r}
library(leaflet)

# Create data frame of locations
locations <- data.frame(
  name = c("Salt Lake City (SLC)", "Honolulu (HNL)"),
  lat = c(40.7608, 21.3069),
  lon = c(-111.8910, -157.8583)
)

# Create leaflet map
leaflet(locations) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~name
  ) %>%
  addPolylines(
    lng = locations$lon,
    lat = locations$lat,
    color = "blue",
    weight = 2
  )
```
